title: External Cognitive Scaffolding for ADHD and Executive Dysfunction
background: This module evaluates coaching, executive-function-focused CBT, organizational-skills interventions, checklists, reminders, digital aids, assistive technology, and occupational redesign, including durability and harms.
population: Adolescents and adults with ADHD or clinically meaningful executive dysfunction.
intervention: Coaching, executive-function-focused CBT, checklists, reminders, organizational-skills training, digital aids, assistive technology, structured deadlines, or occupational/educational redesign.
comparator: Usual care, waitlist, active control, alternative intervention, or pre-intervention baseline.

outcomes_primary.name: Real-world task completion, omissions, functioning, or quality of life

outcomes_secondary.name: ADHD symptoms, adherence, academic or occupational performance, and evidence for AI assistance

inclusion: Adolescent or adult ADHD or executive-dysfunction population.
Evaluates an external scaffold or executive-function support intervention.
Includes a functional, performance, quality-of-life, durability, acceptability, or harm outcome.
Empirical intervention study or authoritative evidence synthesis.
exclusion: Medication-only intervention without an external scaffold.
No separable ADHD or executive-dysfunction population.
Protocol, opinion, or commercial treatment claim without empirical data.
No outcome relevant to claim H4.

analysis.effect_measure: Intervention-specific narrative synthesis; pool only homogeneous outcomes after human review.

registration: Protocol frozen for AI-assisted rapid review on 2026-07-29; not prospectively registered.
disclaimer: AI Reviewer-1 rapid-review draft. Human Reviewer 2 and clinical sign-off remain pending. Not diagnostic or treatment guidance.
